results.title: An fara taron tattalin arziƙin ƙasashen Asia da Pacific a China
results.content: An faro taron tattalin arziƙi da haɗin kan ƙasashen nahiyar Asia da Pacif wanda China ke karɓar baƙonci a birnin Shenzhen, taron da ke haɗa manyan shugabannin ƙasashen duniya irin mai masaukin baƙi Xi Jinpin kan takwarorinsa na Rasha Vladimir Putin da kuma Donald Trump na Amurka, haɗuwa mai cike da tarihi tsakanin ƙasashen 3 mafiya ƙarfin nukiliya a duniya.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Afrika na asarar biliyoyin daloli duk shekara sabida haramtattun hada-hada
results.content: Hukumar yaƙi da rashawa ta Afrika, ta ce ƙasashen nahiyar na tafka hasarar kimanin Dala biliyan 125, sakamakon hada-hadar kuɗaɗe ta haramtattun hanyoyi, yayin da kuma wasu biliyoyin Dalar ke zurarewa a dalilin cin hanci da rashawa.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Rikici ya ɓarke tsakanin Jam'iyyar ADC da gwamnatin Kaduna kan filin taro
results.content: Cacar baka ta barƙe tsakanin Jam'iyyar ADC da gwamnatin jihar Kaduna dake Najeriya dangane da hana jam'iyyar wurin da za ta gudanar da taron ƴakin neman zaɓen ɗan takarar ta Atiku Abubakar.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Ghana ta sanar da matakai 5 da ya kamata Afrika ta ɗauka don magance ƙaurar baƙi
results.content: Shugaban Ghana John Dramani Mahama ya bayyana wasu matakai biyar da ya kamata ƙasashen Afrika su ɗauka don daƙile matsalar ƙaura da ƴan nahiyar ke yi wanda ke barazana ga tsaro da lafiyar su.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Iran ta kai hare-hare ƙasashen Gulf ƙawayen Amurka bayan harin da ta kai mata
results.content: Ƙasashen yankin Gulf sun ce sun samu nasarar daƙile wasu hare-haren da Iran da ƙawayenta suke kai musu, waɗanda ke a matsayin martini, sakamakon harin da Amurka ta kai tsibirin Qeshm, lamarin da ke barazanar kawo cikas ga ƙoƙarin kawo ƙarshen yaƙin da ake yi a yankin.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Majalisar dattawar Najeriya ta miƙa wa Tinubu ƙudirin samar da ƴansandan jihohi
results.content: Majalisar dattawar Najeriya ta umarci akawunta ya tura wa shugaban ƙasar Bola Ahmed Tinubu, ƙudirin dokar samar da ƴansandan jihohi da suka amince ta ita, don sanya hannu ta zama doka.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: An buɗe bikin baje kolin amfanin gonar Najeriya
results.content: Ƙungiyar manoman Najeriya ta AFAN ta bayyana gamsuwa da yawan manoma da kuma kamfanonin da suka halarci bikin baje kolin amfanin gonan bana dake gudana yanzu haka a Keffi.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Mayaƙan ADF sun hallaka mutum 44 a hare-haren da suka kai gabashin Congo
results.content: Wasu hare haren da mayaƙan ADF suka kai da jirage marasa matuka a lardin Ituri da ke arewa maso gabashin Congo ya hallaka akalla mutum 44.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Rikicin siyasar Gombe na ƙara haifar da ruɗani gameda babban zaɓen Najeriya
results.content: Yayin da ya rage watanni biyu a gudanar da babban zaɓen Najeriya na shekarar 2027, ana samun ƙarin damuwa kan yadda rikice-rikicen siyasa da barazanar tashin hankali, yayin gangamin yaƙin neman zaɓe a jihar Gombe ke tayar hakulan al’umma.

results.title: Pochettino ya isa Old Trafford don fara jagorancin tawagar Manchester United
results.content: Sa’o’i bayan ajje aikin sa a matsayin manajan tawagar ƙwallon ƙafar Amurka, Mauricio Pochettino a jiya Laraba ya isa Old Trafford don fara aikin horar da ƴan wasan Manchester United.

results.title: Arder Guler ya tsawaita yarjejeniyar zamansa a Real Madrid zuwa 2032
results.content: Matashin ɗan wasan tsakiyar Real Madrid Arda Guler ya tsawaita kwantiragin zamansa a ƙungiyar ta Spain zuwa nan da shekarar 2032.

results.title: Sabon jadawalin FIFA ya sanya Morocco a gaban Portugal da Brazil a fagen iya ƙwallo
results.content: Morocco ta koma matsayin ta 5 a jadawalin FIFA na ƙasashe mafiya iya ƙwallo a matakin duniya baki ɗaya, wanda ya bata damar kafa tarihin kaiwa matakin da Najeriya ta taɓa kaiwa mafi ƙololuwa a irin wannan jadawali da FIFA kan fitar.

results.title: Ƙungiyoyin kwadago a Faransa na shirin fara yajin aiki
results.content: Kwanaki bayan lafawar zanga-zangar ɗalibai ta tsawon makwanni a Faransa, ƙungiyoyin ƙwadago sun sake kiran wani yajin aikin ƙasa baki ɗaya haɗe da bore ga gwamnatin bayan ƙin amincewa ƙarin albashin ma’aikata.

results.title: Najeriya ta kama wasu ƙasurguman masu safarar ƙwayoyi ɗauke da tarin hodar Iblis
results.content: Hukumar yaƙi da yaƙi da sha da kuma fataucin miyagun ƙwayoyi ta Najeriya NDLEA, ta cafke wasu mutane 8, waɗanda ake kyautata zaton suna da alaƙa da wani gungun masu safarar muggan ƙwayoyi daga Afrika zuwa Turai.

results.title: An gurfanar da Jagoran adawar Mozambique a gaban ƙotu kan laifin tunzura jama'a
results.content: An soma shari’ar jagoran adawar Mozambique Venancio Mondlane a wata babbar ƙotu da ke Maputo.

results.title: Ƙotu a Spain ta hukunta mutumin da aka samu da laifin cin zarafin Mbappe
results.content: Ƙotu a Spain ta samu wani mai goyan ƙungiyar kwallon Ovieda da laifin cin zarafin zakaran kwallon kafar Faransa Kylian Mbappe .

results.title: Gwamnatin Guinea ta ɗaure wasu tsoffin jami'anta shekaru biyu-biyu a gidan yari
results.content: Kotu a Guinea Conakry ta yanke hukuncin ɗauri kan wasu tsoffin manyan jami’an gwamanti su 22, saboda samun su da hannu wajen bai wa jama’a damar haƙar zinari ba kan ƙa’ida ba a yankin Siguiri da ke Arewa masu Gabashin ƙasar.
